'''Blik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was rumored that Blik gained employment with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and helped program their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. However, later during the conflict, he took an assignment working for the [[Believers]], who were attempting to release a virus on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. He flew there in his modified [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] ''[[Ku'Amo]]'', with his droid [[I4-M9]] aboard it as well. He landed it on the planet and assisted a group of Believers, but their plot was eventually thwarted by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />
